ownership.quote: BuildJet makes CI faster by running its own cloud on top of Gaming CPUs

stage.note: Confirmed as a YC W23 company (independently verified via the YC company page, same buildjet.com domain, founders Adam Shiervani and Lian Duan). No priced round (amount, date, or investors) was disclosed on the YC page, the company's own blog/pricing/about pages, or via web search (DuckDuckGo and Bing searches returned no usable results in the time available). YC itself typically provides pre-seed/seed-stage funding to accepted companies, but no dollar figure or round type is publicly confirmed for BuildJet.

note: BuildJet for GitHub Actions (co-founders Adam Shiervani and Lian Duan) is a YC W23 company, listed as 'Active' on YC's own directory as of the check date, but the product itself has shut down: the company announced on 2026-02-06 that 'BuildJet for GitHub Actions is shutting down', stopped new signups immediately, and stopped running jobs on 2026-03-31, 2026, directing users to migrate to GitHub's own hosted runners. The homepage now reads 'BuildJet for GitHub Actions has been shut down.' No funding round, total funding, or revenue figures were disclosed anywhere found (YC page, company blog/pricing/about pages, or web search).
